1. Introduction

Hill Shire Landscaping (“we”, “us”, “our”) is a family-owned landscaping business operating across The Hills Shire, NSW. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and disclose your information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).

By contacting us or using our website, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

2. Information We Collect

We only collect information that helps us provide you with a quote and complete your landscaping work. This may include:

  • Your name, phone number and email address
  • Your suburb or property address, so we can visit and quote
  • Details about the work you’re after and your property
  • Any information you provide through our contact or quote forms, by phone, or by email
  • Basic, non-identifying website analytics (such as pages visited), where enabled

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your personal information to:

  • Prepare and provide your free quote
  • Arrange and carry out the landscaping services you request
  • Communicate with you about your job, including scheduling and follow-up
  • Issue invoices and keep records for our business
  • Respond to your enquiries and improve our service

We do not sell your personal information, and we don’t send marketing you haven’t asked for.

4. Disclosure of Information

We keep your information in-house wherever possible. We may share limited information with trusted third parties only where necessary — for example, a supplier delivering materials to your site, or our accountant for invoicing. We may also disclose information where required by law. We do not disclose your information overseas.

5. Storing & Protecting Your Information

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from misuse, loss, and unauthorised access. Information is stored securely and kept only for as long as we need it for the purpose it was collected, or as required by law.

6. Accessing & Correcting Your Information

You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, or ask us to correct it if it’s wrong or out of date. Just get in touch on 0451 267 287 or info@hillshirelandscaping.com.au and we’ll help.

7. Cookies & Our Website

Our website may use basic cookies to help it work properly and to understand how visitors use it. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time, though some parts of the site may not work as well.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version will always be published on this page with the “last updated” date shown above.

9. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact Hill Shire Landscaping on 0451 267 287 or at info@hillshirelandscaping.com.au.

Questions about this page? Contact Hill Shire Landscaping on 0451 267 287 or info@hillshirelandscaping.com.au.
